mapper.select: SELECT 0 AS type, ppo.production_line_id as productLineId, ppo.material_id, any_value(ppo.material_code), any_value(ppo.material_name), prw.classes_id, sum( prw.process_quantity ) AS quantity, any_value(prw.unit_id) FROM pms_report_work prw JOIN pms_produce_order ppo ON prw.produce_order_id = ppo.id GROUP BY ppo.production_line_id, ppo.material_id, prw.classes_id UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS type, ppo.production_line_id as productLineId, ppo.material_id, any_value(ppo.material_code), any_value(ppo.material_name), pcsi.classes_id, sum( pcsi.quantity ) AS quantity, any_value(pcsi.unit_id) FROM pms_complete_storage_info pcsi JOIN pms_produce_order ppo ON pcsi.produce_order_id = ppo.id GROUP BY ppo.production_line_id, ppo.material_id, pcsi.classes_id
SELECT classes_id , sum(process_quantity) as process_quantity FROM pms_report_work where product_line_id = #{productLineId} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = #{date} GROUP BY classes_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') date,
classes_id groupId,
product_line_id groupId,
sum(process_quantity) quantity FROM pms_report_work WHERE
#{id} and (c.create_time >= #{startTime} and c.create_time <= #{endTime}) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d'),
classes_id
product_line_id
